answer: Farming becomes a wander bet on surviving 93 epochs of grading, and every mesa settlement recomputes the comet schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 93 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 12 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 24 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
